scheme_name: Haryana Post Matric Scholarship For Minority
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, or Zoroastrian (Parsi) community.
Minimum of 50% marks in the previous final examination.
Must be a regular student in a government or private higher secondary school, college, or university.
Must not be receiving any other scholarship for the same purpose.
Preference is given to students from BPL families.
30% of scholarships are earmarked for girl students.
benefits_summary: Provides admission and tuition fee reimbursement plus a monthly maintenance allowance (up to ₹1,200) for eligible minority students.
